description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker qwen3.6-35b-a3b-fp8-dflash recipe: Qwen's official Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 (block-wise FP8, Apache-2.0; checkpoint revision 95a723d0) with the z-lab Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-DFlash draft model (Apache-2.0; revision f181eece) for DFlash speculative decoding, served by vLLM on a single Spark. Runs eugr's published vllm-node image (nightly-20260929, digest pinned; its build-metadata records spark-vllm-docker 42f62e34, vLLM 0.30.1rc1.dev336+gaf5b4857e and FlashInfer 4a638133) with upstream's launch: VLLM_MARLIN_USE_ATOMIC_ADD=1, flash_attn attention, default KV cache dtype, fastsafetensors loading, no prefix caching (upstream's changelog says it was disabled for the DFlash recipe because it caused accuracy issues), qwen3 reasoning and qwen3_xml tool parsing, eugr's fix-qwen3.6-chat-template mod (baked into the image at build time; the chat template it installs is selected with --chat-template), DFlash with 15 speculative tokens (the draft model is mounted as a second model), 262,144-token context, 16,384 batched tokens and memory utilisation 0.8 (upstream defaults); scheduler sequence capacity is left to vLLM as upstream does not set it. Upstream's recipe is written for two Sparks; eugr's --solo mode runs the same command at tensor parallel 1 (the only override), which is this single-Spark recipe. No upstream performance claims are recorded for this recipe. Upstream repository MIT. The same weights without the draft model are the separate qwen3-6-35b-a3b-fp8 recipes, because options cannot add model files. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. Version 1.0.1 (2026-09-30) adds a single `speculation` selector (DFlash default or native Qwen3.6 MTP) and a `modality` selector (multimodal default or zero-limit language-model-only). On the pinned vLLM release that mode disables multimodal inputs but retains the Qwen3.5 vision tower, so it is not a VRAM-reduction switch. The native MTP choice uses the MTP head already in the pinned FP8 checkpoint and the pinned vLLM parser; it adds no model files, image changes, or runtime downloads. Sources: https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8/tree/95a723d08a9490559dae23d0cff1d9466213d989 and https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/af5b4857e/vllm/engine/arg_utils.py. Memory follows the creator's settings: gpu-memory-utilization 0.8 as in eugr's recipes/qwen3.6-35b-a3b-fp8-dflash.yaml at 4709188d (lines 26-28). The steady per-node peak is 0.8 x 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus 8 GB for CUDA context, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers (a speculative draft is profiled inside the utilization budget); the reserve is 8 GB, and admission keeps the platform memory floor free beside the peak.
title: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B FP8 DFlash vLLM single Spark (eugr)
